description: This is a test source file for the UserPreferencesSerializer class in the Android project's datastore module. It contains unit tests to verify the serialization and deserialization of user preferences, including default value testing, reading/writing correctness, and corruption handling.

classes.name: UserPreferencesSerializerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for UserPreferencesSerializer, testing default values, read/write operations, and error handling.

methods.name: defaultUserPreferences_isEmpty
methods.description: Tests that the default user preferences are empty or have the expected default state.

methods.name: writingAndReadingUserPreferences_outputsCorrectValue
methods.description: Verifies that writing and then reading user preferences produces the expected consistent result using in-memory streams.

methods.name: readingInvalidUserPreferences_throwsCorruptionException
methods.description: Ensures that corrupted input streams trigger the appropriate exception during deserialization.
